detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 🦶😄 Neuroscientists surveyed 448 adults from Chinese, Dutch, and Greek backgrounds about their ticklishness, finding similar responses across # cultures . The # neck , # armpits , # abdomen , and # feet ranked among the most common sensitive spots, yielding a body map of ticklishness. Patterns partially matched # Darwin ’s idea that less-touched areas may be more ticklish, within a mix of physiological and # social influences. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/health/researchers- make-a-ticklishness-body-map/ # tickling # neuroscience # science # body # research # culture # evolution # psychology # animals
